home.title: Shipilka Gathering
home.description: An information site for the Shipilka Gathering held in VRChat, with event archives and participation rules.
home.heroBody: Shipilka Gathering is an avatar meetup for Shipilka-kun, mainly held in VRChat. First-timers and returning visitors are both welcome.
closingLines: That's the end of the scroll.
home.heroImageAlt: An illustration of many Shipilka-kuns gathered around the moon
home.heroBottomAlt: An illustration of many Shipilka-kuns standing on a mirror-like lake

sections.title: Required
sections.imageAlt: An illustration of Shipilka-kun raising a finger to give a warning

items.text: Please follow any instructions from the staff.
children: Depending on crowding, you may be asked to move to a new instance.

sections.title: Allowed
sections.imageAlt: An illustration of Shipilka-kun standing in a welcoming pose

items.text: You may join with a sample avatar.
children: If you do not have a sample avatar, please ask a staff member.

items.text: Photography is allowed inside the instance.
children: Photos may be used on social media or in event announcements.

sections.title: Not allowed
sections.imageAlt: An illustration of Shipilka-kun upside down as a warning

items.text: Do not use avatars that fall under any of the following:
children: Extreme chimera avatars that damage the avatar's reputation
Avatars that violate terms of use

sections.footer: Staff may remove you from the instance without prior notice at their discretion.
